mapper.select: select id, username, password, nickname, avatar_url as avatarUrl, role, created_time as createdTime from user where username = #{username} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user ( username, password, nickname, avatar_url, role, created_time ) values ( #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{role}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: select * from user where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into history (user_id, music_id, play_time) values (#{userId}, #{musicId}, now())
mapper.select: select id, username, nickname, avatar_url, role, created_time from user order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
